task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, and if it is, look for similar audio alternatives, pick the best option for 1 item, turn that into a cart item, apply the SAVE15 coupon, prepare checkout with my credit card, and place the order. Then add the best recommendation for the black XM5 to my cart, format those cart details into a message, generate an invoice for 1 black XM5 using the best available discount and send it to user@example.com through Stripe, check my living room AC status and set it to eco mode at 22°C, and after that send Alex an app alert with the formatted cart message.

Also check my living room AC with device_id ac_living, see its status, and set it to eco mode at 22°C. After that, send Alex an app alert on the app channel with the formatted cart message.
